name: TenTen-Tencent
one_liner: AI-augmented enterprise knowledge system that unifies Confluence, Jira, Slack, and Google Drive under permission-aware retrieval with full audit trail.
problem: Enterprises waste 30% of workweek searching for information scattered across Confluence, Jira, Slack, and Google Drive. Existing AI assistants ignore access controls entirely — a junior engineer can leak security-team-only pages. The Internal Brain solves this with RBAC-enforced retrieval and tamper-evident audit logging.
market: Enterprise IT / engineering teams at companies with 500+ employees using multiple knowledge platforms
